thread:
mike: heads-up — opened a PR to tweak the inference-sidecar Deployment rollout + PVC wiring: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/482

jess: quick Q — why keep this as a Deployment instead of converting to a StatefulSet?

mike: we chatted about STS but pods don't need stable ordinals. volume is a shared NFS mount (ReadOnlyMany) for cached artifacts, so no per-pod PVC needed. keeping Deployment simplifies HPA.

sarah: ok. can we tighten the rolling update windows? current defaults let too many pods go down during bursts.

mike: proposing this patch in the k8s manifest (snippet in PR):

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
spec:
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 0
```

also adding a startupProbe/readinessProbe tweak so we don't mark pods ready before cache warmed.

ben: +1 on maxUnavailable=0. Also suggest a short startupProbe to wait for warmup:

```yaml
startupProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /healthz/startup
    port: 8080
  failureThreshold: 10
  periodSeconds: 5
readinessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /healthz/ready
    port: 8080
  initialDelaySeconds: 15
  periodSeconds: 10
```

infra-bot: terraform plan for modules/k8s/inference_sidecar shows:

```
~ kubernetes_deployment.inference_sidecar
    spec[0].strategy.0.rolling_update.0.max_surge:         "25%" => "1"
    spec[0].strategy.0.rolling_update.0.max_unavailable:  "50%" => "0"
```

mike: also adding a small canary label rollout (10% by node selector + label) and ensuring HPA minReplicas=2 so we never scale to 0. Command I'll run post-merge: `kubectl rollout status deploy/inference-sidecar -w`

jess: nit: switch secret path to use the teams KMS-managed secret `secret/redwood/inference/sidecar` instead of the module default. pinging @security for rotation policy. :thumbsup:

security: noted. please add kms_key_id and secret_path vars to the tfvars file. rotation window should be 90d; we'll verify in the secrets audit job.

mike: thanks. will update tfvars and PR. expected to merge after CI (unit + kubeconformance) pass. tagging @oncall in case rollout shows token storms.

deploy-bot: started canary rollout for inference-sidecar (canary=10%) — deploying sha:9f2c3a, target nodes: us-west-2a

jess: LGTM after the secret path change. thanks for the clear plan.

mike: merged and monitoring. will post a short follow-up if we see any increased 5xxs or CPU spikes.
